method: Mutually exclusive best-Meta-improvement scenarios, with final-first probabilities conditional on competition and publication. No conversion of current rank or rating bounds into forecast probability.
literal:
This market will resolve according to the company which owns the model which has the highest arena rank based off the Chatbot Arena LLM Leaderboard (https://lmarena.ai/) when the table under the "Leaderboard" tab is checked on December 31, 2026, 12:00 PM ET.

Results from the "Rank" section on the Leaderboard tab of https://lmarena.ai/leaderboard/text with the style control off will be used to resolve this market.

Models will be ordered primarily by their leaderboard rank at the market’s check time. If two or more models are tied on rank, they will be ordered by their Arena score, including any underlying, unrounded, granular values reflected in the data below the leaderboard. If a tie remains, alphabetical order of company names as listed in this market group will be used as a final tiebreaker (e.g., if the two models are tied by exact arena score, “Google” would be ranked ahead of “xAI”). This market will resolve based on the company that occupies first place under this ranking system.

The resolution source for this market is the Chatbot Arena LLM Leaderboard found at https://lmarena.ai/. If this resolution source is unavailable at check time, this market will remain open until the leaderboard comes back online and resolve based on the first check after it becomes available. If it becomes permanently unavailable, this market will resolve based on another resolution source.
company_identity: Meta owns Muse; original Meta release corroborates publisher organization attribution. Single Meta condition only; no completeness assumption over15 listed companies, since current dataset also contains unlisted organizations.

dated_facts.scope: Full absent from this snapshot only; not unavailable to public or absent in other categories/later data.

source_bridge: The published baseline is behind Google by30.6100 rating points, so maturity of the same entry alone is unlikely to win. Meta released Wonder and Full Oct12; Full is publicly accessible to MuseCode subscribers but unranked here, a real future-entry path. Agent/coding benchmarks are not raw text preference rank. No dated next-model release found; product rollout wording soon does not promise a frontier launch.71days allows competitor updates as well as Meta progress.

branches.label: No effective new Meta leader: existing Wonder/matured votes remain the best eligible Meta entry
Already-released Full or an incremental variant enters and improves Meta, with competitors also updating
Substantial Meta scaling/model breakthrough before cutoff; competitors still respond

reasoning: Final-first chance10.95% rounds11%. The45/40/15 scenario weights and1/15/30% conditional chances are explicit, unfitted primary judgments. The Full path has weight because an actual larger variant exists, not because its Arena rank is known. Competition can preserve Google/Anthropic leads or favor another lab; rank6 does not mean1/6 win probability.

rivals.label: Agent-specific gains fail raw-text preference; no successful Full entry
Full closes the preference gap while other labs improve
Major Meta leap and favorable final publication timing

uncertainty: No live designated UI read: observed403, no retry; dated publisher dataset is a derivative. Config/style mapping receipt awaited, not assumed to certify live UI equality.
Publisher rating bounds have no verified confidence level here, and are not forward innovation uncertainty. Two Oct15/20 observations do not estimate a trend.
No official future release schedule or external general-preference rating for Full; scenario weights uncalibrated.
Primary rank then unrounded score then exact listed-company alphabetical tie; ownership/late source outage can delay cutoff.
reserve_basis: Forward competitive releases and source/ranking uncertainty;15pp planning stress is not an empirically calibrated confidence floor. Broad0.3–50% covers more adverse/favorable mechanisms.
next_catalysts: Full appears in a correctly configured leaderboard snapshot
Meta or competing lab release/model update
Dec31 12:00ET/17UTC exact check; outage delays first check
portfolio: No entry. Existing Kimi/HLE and OpenRouter pilots share model competition, data-publication and AI operational risks; no statistical independence or hedge credit. Other exact best-company contracts can be mutually exclusive only under demonstrated same-rule/current conditions.600+primary-comparison pause remains.
